en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a historic Italian square with cobblestone pavement. In the foreground is a stone lion sculpture at the base of a column. In the background stands a tall medieval clock or civic tower with Ghibelline-style battlements, attached to or overlooking a long palazzo façade with arched doors, balconies, and shuttered windows. Several people are gathered in the square. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the scene as 'TRENTO - Torre Grande' along with a small serial number.
